Card Q&A.q: Two of my opponent's Digimon reach zero DP and are deleted simultaneously. Can I draw 2 cards?

Card Q&A.a: No, the deletion of multiple Digimon using [BT2-041 ShineGreymon]'s skill is treated as occurring at the same timing, so you only draw 1 card.
Card Q&A.q: I use BT2-041 [ShineGreymon]'s [When Digivolving] effect to delete 2 or more of my opponent's Digimon simultaneously. Does this mean I can draw 2 cards?

Inherited Effect: [Your Turn] When an opponent's Digimon is deleted by dropping to 0 DP, trigger ＜Draw 1＞ (Draw 1 card from your deck).
